note: Cayman Islands: Workforce Opportunities and Residency Cayman grants a Temporary Work Permit on its form T1 (revised August 2026), applied for by the employee and the employer together; its checklist sets the entertainment industry's additional requirements, a musical or theatrical entertainer's demo of the show to be performed and, for an event, its advertising and liquor licence approval. Caymanians are home; no free movement and no days of work without a permit are modelled.
